what_this_is: Traits derived from each curve's model and order (the registry, then the sources in docs/curves/trait-sources.json), with the status of each value; see docs/curves/TRAITS.md.

not_evaluated_families.brainpool_overlap: defined on Brainpool's seed-derived bit strings; the registry records no seeds
not_evaluated_families.class_number: only exact h(d_K) for |d_K| ≤ 10^7 (frobenius.class_number); no analytic bounds
not_evaluated_families.multiples_x: DiSSECT's definition depends on a choice of base point this module does not reproduce
not_evaluated_families.q_torsion: torsion of a lift to Q: the lift is a choice DiSSECT makes and this module does not
not_evaluated_families.square_4p1: the square part of 4q − 1 needs factoring numbers of the size of q; not attempted
not_evaluated_families.weierstrass: the coefficients are in the registry's model_json; not copied
